summary.text: Dustin Burrows is a Republican state representative from Texas House District 83 who has served since 2015 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election, where Democrat Malik Williams is also on the ballot.
He was elected speaker of the Texas House on January 14, 2025.

paragraphs.text: Dustin Burrows was born in Lubbock, Texas, in 1978, and received a bachelor's degree from Rhodes College in 2001 and an M.B.A. and J.D. from Texas Tech University in 2004.
As of November 2025, Ballotpedia lists him as a partner at Burrows Law Firm, P.C.; he was previously a partner at the Lubbock law firm of McCleskey, Harriger, Brazill & Graff.
Burrows assumed office in the Texas House in 2015.
The Texas House elected him speaker on January 14, 2025, after he defeated the Republican House Caucus nominee, Rep. David Cook, 85-55 in two rounds of voting.
